description: What does this Medicare Part D plan cost and cover? Premium, deductible, service area, cost sharing by tier and one drug’s terms for a contract-plan-segment id, computed by Distill from CMS’s monthly formulary files. From CMS’s monthly Part D formulary public use file: a plan by contract-plan-segment (e.g. H0028-063-000) with its formulary id, monthly premium, deductible, service area, and the initial-coverage 30-day cost sharing of every tier at each pharmacy type; with rxcui or ndc, whether the plan covers that drug and on what terms. Updated monthly. Price: $0.01 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the plans and terms are read from the CMS file deterministically): 1 until 45 days after the served file’s date (CMS posts one a month), then halving every 30 days. Medicare Part D formulary and plan data as of the CMS public use file’s date (file_date), processed by Distill; the Medicare Plan Finder (medicare.gov/plan-compare) may have newer information. Not enrollment, coverage or medical advice; confirm with the plan. See /terms.

ndc.description: An 11-digit NDC as the formulary file lists it (one per RxCUI); prefer rxcui.

plan_year.description: The plan (benefit) year, e.g. 2027 for open enrollment (default: the current year).

rxcui.description: The drug’s RxNorm concept id (RxCUI), e.g. 617311 for atorvastatin 40 mg oral tablet.
